observations: Photo 0: Metal transmission/gearbox unit with starter motor attached, coated in dust and grime, sitting on dark workshop floor. A small blue paint/chalk mark visible on casing. Watermark text 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' overlaid on image.

Photo 1: Closer view of the same unit showing starter motor, wiring connectors (loose multi-colored wires hanging), sensor plugs, and metal coolant/oil lines. Surface heavily soiled with dirt and old oil residue.

Photo 2: Another angle of the same transmission casing showing bellhousing side with bolt pattern, torque converter or flywheel opening visible, same blue mark seen in photo 0, resting on workshop floor near other parts.
